summary: Entrada Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing positive topline results from Cohort 1 of the Phase 1/2 ELEVATE-45-201 study of ENTR-601-45 in ambulatory Duchenne muscular dystrophy patients amenable to exon 45 skipping. Cohort 1 enrolled eight participants randomized 3:1 to 5 mg/kg intravenous ENTR-601-45 or placebo, dosed on days one, 43 and 85, with muscle biopsies at screening and six weeks post-final dose; all continued into open-label Phase 2. Cohort 2 (10 mg/kg) enrollment is complete, with data expected in the first half of 2027 and Cohort 3 (up to 15 mg/kg) to follow. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; this is a routine clinical-update current report.
